summary: Finish the GRID loading state and show measured coverage against the actual main-register membership.
modification_note: Distinguishes failed sources from empty coverage, labels baseline fallback, and removes unsupported claims about searches never being run. Extra wider-fleet keys are never counted as measured core records.

app.label: Compute explicit coverage from actual loaded data
Finish the loading state after both metric loaders
Describe unavailable observations without asserting an unperformed search
app.from:
const why = located
      ? "Not measured. 3,047 of the 7,680 records in this cut carry a grid measurement and 4,633 do not. This project has a register coordinate and is one of the 4,605 unmeasured records that do: no search was run for it, so none failed."
      : "Not measurable. The register publishes no usable coordinate for this project, so there is no point on the ground to measure from. 28 of the 7,680 records are in that state, 26 missing and 2 invalid. The record stays searchable and exportable."

app.label: Report finished source failure as unavailable
app.to: if (!ready) return `${label} unavailable`;
